topic: Using Function Pointers as Subscript Operators in Custom Map Types
explanation: In advanced C programming, function pointers can be employed to overload or customize the behavior of operators such as the subscript operator []. By defining a map structure that uses function pointers to handle subscript operations, programmers can implement flexible, dynamic data access mechanisms. This technique leverages C's ability to treat functions as first-class objects, enabling sophisticated abstractions and callback-based designs that go beyond simple data structures.
